# The ARCHV

> The ARCHV is an illustrated sport publication at thearchv.ca, led by Manchester United and football. It publishes reporting on Manchester United transfers, international football and the football leagues, question desks for the NFL, Formula 1, tennis, golf and basketball, and the Wire, a page of headlines from other newsrooms. Its own reporting is checked against a trusted, named source.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://thearchv.ca/): the archive, the desks and the Wire, and the Christmas range and posters from our shop.
- [Shop](https://shop.thearchv.ca): The ARCHV's own shop.
- [Manchester United transfer news](https://thearchv.ca/desk/transfer/): Manchester United moves, each checked against at least one trusted, named source.
- [International football and the World Cup](https://thearchv.ca/desk/world-cup/): men's and women's international football.
- [Football leagues](https://thearchv.ca/desk/leagues/): title races, promotions, sackings and the tables behind them.
- [NFL](https://thearchv.ca/nfl/), [Formula 1](https://thearchv.ca/f1/), [Tennis](https://thearchv.ca/tennis/), [Golf](https://thearchv.ca/golf/) and [Basketball](https://thearchv.ca/basketball/): one question desk per sport.
- [The Wire](https://thearchv.ca/wire/): one headline a day from each permitted newsroom, linked to the publisher. These stories are written by those newsrooms, not by The ARCHV, and are not covered by the checks below.
- [Tables and fixtures](https://thearchv.ca/tables/): league tables and fixtures, updated once a day, with the source of each block credited.
- [Live scores](https://thearchv.ca/scores/): the Premier League, the Champions League and the Women's Super League.
- [Posters](https://thearchv.ca/posters/): the Manchester United final posters in our shop, one match to a poster.
- [Start here](https://thearchv.ca/start/): a short introduction to what The ARCHV is and how to follow it.
- [Football, explained](https://thearchv.ca/explainers/): the rules, the terms and the records, without the jargon. One question per page, answered in the first paragraph. The glossary sits inside it.
- [Glossary](https://thearchv.ca/glossary/): part of Football, explained. Plain, verified definitions of common football terms (xG, the false 9, the offside rule, VAR).
- [Search](https://thearchv.ca/search/): every desk entry, long read, final, explainer, glossary term and legend on the site, searchable by name, club, competition or year.
- [Content feed](https://thearchv.ca/feed/index.json): the machine-readable JSON feed, schema archv-feed/3, that also powers the iOS app.

## Editorial standards

These standards cover The ARCHV's own reporting, not the third-party headlines on the Wire. Every claim is checked against at least one trusted, named source before publication, individual moves are labelled CONFIRMED, REPORTED or RUMOUR, corrections are appended and dated rather than quietly changed, and all artwork is original illustration. The full policy is set out at [How we verify](https://thearchv.ca/about/#how-we-verify).

## Citation

Cite as "The ARCHV (thearchv.ca)" together with the specific article URL.
